description: Video pipeline from PNG to MP4 with premium motion, survives wipes via git, uses ae_motion_enhanced.py

step1_choose_winning_topic.action: Choose priority 1 super-catchup-152k-gap, why winning high pain $152k gap specific numbers genuine

step2_generate_script.action: Generate 90 beats 12-16 words 2-6s each, visuals that resonate house couple money bag piggy bank calendar, edit pop for number slide for new idea pan only when connected

step3_generate_narration.action: TTS voice-05 140-160 WPM 12-16 words 2-6s pause median 0.4s -18.5dB visual 0.2s before keyword, split at sentence boundaries parallel calls low latency

step4_create_visuals.action: Generate PNGs with hand-drawn-styles ms-paint-bad-doodle bean-doodle-infographic whiteboard-explainer, thick outline 0.6% frame black #000 flat 4-6 colors pure white bg #FFFFFF max_dim 600 1 icon+text max 40-60% frame 20% margin
step4_create_visuals.style: hand-drawn-styles style 5 ms-paint-bad-doodle, style 4 bean-doodle, style 19 whiteboard-explainer

step5_animate_with_code.action: Animate with ae_motion_enhanced.py code-driven keyframes pos/scale/rot/opacity/puppet-pin ARAP, easing premium 350-600ms cubic(0.4,0,0.2,1) corporate 200-400ms cubic(0.2,0,0,1) energetic 100-250ms ease-out-expo playful 150-300ms ease-out-back, 3 layers primary+secondary+ambient, Lottie Android money bag coins house SOLD confetti calculator count-up couple high-five checkmark burst, cut median 3.5s hard 98% + 30ms fade
step5_animate_with_code.engine: PIL + ffmpeg 1920x1080 30fps pure white bg crf 18, puppet-warp ARAP fallback simple

step6_add_audio.action: Add narration visual 0.2s before keyword, music corporate ambient 80-90 BPM -37dB ducks -18.5dB vs voice, SFX whoosh same frame 12% pop 0-5ms before 10% impact same frame 8%, voice polish remove dead air >0.8s median pause 0.4s mean -18.5dB
step6_add_audio.code: ffmpeg -i video.mp4 -i audio.mp3 -c:v copy -c:a aac -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -shortest final.mp4

step7_combine.action: Combine 90 beats into 8-10 min video, 0.5s pause + 30ms fade sections + title pop 0.35s, total 2.89MB 104.1s for 20 beats example
step7_combine.code: ffmpeg concat demuxer or ae_motion_enhanced.py combine

step8_preview.action: Preview Studio Port 3001 https://3001-{sandboxId}.e2b.app, Upload Studio Port 3000 fast 29.4 MB/s, MemOS remember, git commit push survives wipes

tools.puppet_warp: pip install puppet-warp --break-system-packages needs libGL.so.1 apt install libgl1 or fallback simple
tools.hyperframes: npx hyperframes lint check preview render
